description: This file contains unit tests for the `ThingId` class in the Eclipse Ditto project. It tests immutability, equality, exception handling, and string representations of `ThingId` instances, focusing on their construction, validity, and dummy identification.

classes.name: ThingIdTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying the behaviors of the `ThingId` class, including immutability, equality, exception handling, and string representation.

methods.name: testImmutability
methods.description: Tests that the `ThingId` class instances are immutable and that `NamespacedEntityId` is also immutable.

methods.name: testEqualsAndHashcode
methods.description: Verifies correct implementation of equals and hashCode methods via EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: dummyIsDummy
methods.description: Checks that the dummy `ThingId` reports as dummy.

methods.name: manuallyCreatedDummyIsDummy
methods.description: Checks that manually created `ThingId` instances with empty or underscore parts are considered dummy.

methods.name: validThingIdIsNoDummy
methods.description: Verifies that valid non-dummy `ThingId` instances are correctly identified.

methods.name: toStringConcatenatesNamespaceAndName
methods.description: Checks the string representation of `ThingId` combines namespace and name properly.

methods.name: returnsCorrectNamespace
methods.description: Verifies that `getNamespace()` returns the correct namespace.

methods.name: returnsCorrectName
methods.description: Verifies that `getName()` returns the correct name.

methods.name: generateRandomHasEmptyNamespace
methods.description: Checks that generated random `ThingId` has an empty namespace.

methods.name: thingIdOfThingIdReturnsSameInstance
methods.description: Ensures that calling `ThingId.of()` with an existing `ThingId` returns the same instance.
